brief: The Claude Code stack a one-person founder uses to ship like a 10-person team. Each tool, what it does, why it matters.

slots.title: 2. Claude Code, the engineer
slots.body: It reads your entire codebase, writes features, fixes bugs, and runs tests. You describe what you want; it edits files and commits code. It cuts development time by half.

slots.title: 3. Next.js, the frontend
slots.body: React framework with server components, API routes, and file-based routing built in. One codebase handles SEO, auth, and dynamic pages. It ships fast without configuring a server.

slots.title: 4. Vercel, the deployer
slots.body: Push to Git and your site builds, deploys, and updates globally in seconds. Preview branches test every pull request automatically. Zero DevOps overhead for a solo founder.

slots.title: 5. Supabase, the backend
slots.body: Postgres database, auth, and storage with a REST API auto-generated. Row-level security handles permissions without backend code. It replaces a dedicated backend engineer.

slots.title: 6. Stripe, the cashier
slots.body: Accept payments, manage subscriptions, and send invoices with a few API calls. Webhooks update your database when customers pay. Revenue runs on autopilot from day one.

slots.title: 7. Figma, the designer
slots.body: Design interfaces, prototype interactions, and export assets in one file. Share links with stakeholders for instant feedback. No handoff gap means you ship pixels, not promises.
